technical.summary: Mixed signals with long-term structure support (above 200-EMA, Ichimoku cloud) but weakened by negative MACD histogram, overbought stochRSI, low ADX trend strength, and distribution pressure from CMF.

fundamental.summary: LMT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, and no lobbying activity; earnings in 27 days present timing risk with minimal fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale vs 2 small purchases) and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (301.76), strong dollar pressures multinationals, FOMC event today adds binary risk, and earnings in 27 days create additional volatility exposure.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-EMA with Ichimoku bullish structure and extreme fear sentiment (contrarian buy signal) offers long-term structural support despite near-term weakness.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, FOMC event today), negative MACD histogram, overbought stochRSI, zero fundamental conviction, and high earnings risk in 27 days create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Already holding LMT with 30 existing Industrials positions creates dangerous sector concentration; macro environment (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, FOMC today) and earnings in 27 days present unacceptable binary risk for swing trade entry.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC event today combined with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis levels creates macro shock risk; earnings in 27 days will force volatility spike regardless of technicals.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Existing LMT position + 30 Industrials holdings = 19% sector concentration; adding swing trade violates concentration limits and amplifies drawdown risk in crisis macro environment.
